title: Fulgentius, Expositio Virgilianae continentiae — Exposition of the Content of Vergil; Фульгенций, «Изъяснение содержания Вергилия» (RU-gap)
author: Fabius Planciades Fulgentius
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia lists Russian only for the Mitologiae (Гусейнов 1988; Можелян 2012/2014; Болгов 2015–16); nothing for this work or the Expositio sermonum antiquorum
en_evidence: Whitbread, Fulgentius the Mythographer (1971); also McVeigh, Hardison (search results)
value: Reads the Aeneid as the stages of human life, with Vergil himself appearing as interpreter. A bridge to medieval allegory; short and vivid, so a good fast pilot
ai_feasibility: high — short; ornate, mannered Latin needs care
